credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Watercolor sketch of a girl's head and shoulders, facing forward. The image is located in the center of the page and from the shoulders on up the figure is encircled  by green splotches of paint.The rest of the paper is filled by negative space.The girl has a rich brown complexion and short black hair, she is wearing a red and blue shirt. Her gaze is aimed directly at the viewer.
